package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sync/atomic"

	"example.invalid/base64checkpoint/dispatch"
)

func appendErrors() {
	long := make([]byte, 2*1024*1024+4)
	copy(long, "QUJD")
	for i := 4; i < len(long); i++ { long[i] = '=' }
	for _, row := range []struct { encoding *base64.Encoding; input []byte }{
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("TQ==")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("TWE=")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("TWFu")},
		{base64.RawStdEncoding, []byte("TQ")},
		{base64.StdEncoding.Strict(), []byte("TR==")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("QUJD====")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("TQ=\n=")},
		{base64.StdEncoding.WithPadding('#'), []byte("TQ##")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, long},
	} {
		dst := make([]byte, 4, 32)
		copy(dst, "seed")
		output, err := row.encoding.AppendDecode(dst, row.input)
		fmt.Printf("output=%x err=%v shared=%t\n", output, err, &output[0] == &dst[0])
	}
	shared := []byte("seedTQ==")
	output, err := base64.StdEncoding.AppendDecode(shared[:4], shared[4:])
	fmt.Printf("overlap=%x err=%v\n", output, err)
}

func appendProgress(mode string) {
	const size = 24*1024*1024
	count := size
	if mode == "append-offset" { count += 17 }
	if mode == "append-custom" { count = 2*1024*1024 }
	prefix := mode == "append-prefix" || mode == "append-custom"
	input := make([]byte, count)
	padding := byte('=')
	encoding := base64.StdEncoding
	if mode == "append-custom" { padding = '#'; encoding = base64.StdEncoding.WithPadding('#') }
	for i := range input { input[i] = padding }
	if prefix { input = append([]byte("QUJD"), input...) }
	dst := make([]byte, 4, 32)
	copy(dst, "seed")
	dispatch.Enable()
	var ran atomic.Bool
	if mode != "append-alone" {
		ready, start := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
		go func() { close(ready); <-start; ran.Store(true) }()
		<-ready
		close(start)
	}
	output, err := encoding.AppendDecode(dst, input)
	siblingBeforeReturn := ran.Load()
	yieldsBeforeReturn := dispatch.Count()
	expected, offset := "seed", int64(0)
	if prefix { expected, offset = "seedABC", 4 }
	cause, ok := err.(base64.CorruptInputError)
	if !ok || int64(cause) != offset || string(output) != expected || &output[0] != &dst[0] {
		panic("append output, error or backing mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Printf("mode=%s sibling=%t bytes=%d error=%d yields=%d\n", mode, siblingBeforeReturn, len(output), offset, yieldsBeforeReturn)
}

func decodeErrors() {
	long := make([]byte, 2*1024*1024+1)
	for i := range long { long[i] = 'A' }
	long[len(long)-1] = '!'
	for _, row := range []struct { encoding *base64.Encoding; input []byte }{
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("Zm9v!")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, []byte("TQ=")},
		{base64.RawStdEncoding, []byte("TQ")},
		{base64.StdEncoding.Strict(), []byte("TR==")},
		{base64.URLEncoding, []byte("_-4=\r\n")},
		{base64.StdEncoding, long},
	} {
		output := make([]byte, row.encoding.DecodedLen(len(row.input)))
		n, err := row.encoding.Decode(output, row.input)
		sum := sha256.Sum256(output[:n])
		fmt.Printf("n=%d digest=%x err=%v\n", n, sum, err)
	}
}

func decodeProgress(mode string) {
	const size = 24*1024*1024
	var input []byte
	expected := 0
	expectedByte := byte(0)
	switch mode {
	case "decode", "decode-alone":
		input = make([]byte, size)
		for i := range input { input[i] = 'A' }
		expected = size / 4 * 3
	case "decode-newlines":
		input = make([]byte, 2*1024*1024)
		for i := range input { input[i] = '\n' }
	case "decode-pad-middle", "decode-pad-end":
		input = make([]byte, 2*1024*1024+4)
		for i := range input { input[i] = '\n' }
		copy(input, "TQ=")
		if mode == "decode-pad-middle" { input[len(input)-1] = '=' } else { input[3] = '=' }
		expected, expectedByte = 1, 'M'
	case "decode-mixed":
		input = make([]byte, 9*512*1024)
		for i := range input { if i % 9 == 8 { input[i] = '\n' } else { input[i] = 'A' } }
		expected = 6*512*1024
	default: panic("unknown decode mode")
	}
	output := make([]byte, base64.StdEncoding.DecodedLen(len(input)))
	dispatch.Enable()
	var ran atomic.Bool
	if mode != "decode-alone" {
		ready, start := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
		go func() { close(ready); <-start; ran.Store(true) }()
		<-ready
		close(start)
	}
	n, err := base64.StdEncoding.Decode(output, input)
	siblingBeforeReturn := ran.Load()
	yieldsBeforeReturn := dispatch.Count()
	if err != nil || n != expected { panic("decode length or error") }
	for _, value := range output[:n] { if value != expectedByte { panic("decode output mismatch") } }
	fmt.Printf("mode=%s sibling=%t bytes=%d yields=%d\n", mode, siblingBeforeReturn, n, yieldsBeforeReturn)
}

func semantics() {
	for _, row := range []struct{ plain, encoded string }{
		{"", ""}, {"f", "Zg=="}, {"fo", "Zm8="}, {"foo", "Zm9v"},
		{"foob", "Zm9vYg=="}, {"fooba", "Zm9vYmE="}, {"foobar", "Zm9vYmFy"},
	} {
		if base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(row.plain)) != row.encoded { panic("RFC encoding mismatch") }
	}
	for _, enc := range []*base64.Encoding{base64.StdEncoding, base64.RawStdEncoding, base64.URLEncoding, base64.RawURLEncoding} {
		for _, size := range []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 63, 64, 65, 191, 192, 193, 4097, 196610} {
			input := make([]byte, size)
			for i := range input { input[i] = byte(i*37 + 11) }
			encoded := make([]byte, enc.EncodedLen(size))
			enc.Encode(encoded, input)
			decoded := make([]byte, enc.DecodedLen(len(encoded)))
			n, err := enc.Decode(decoded, encoded)
			if err != nil || n != len(input) { panic("roundtrip size") }
			for i := range input { if input[i] != decoded[i] { panic("roundtrip data") } }
		}
	}
	fmt.Printf("semantics=ok yields=%d\n", dispatch.Count())
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "semantics" { dispatch.Enable(); semantics(); return }
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "append-errors" { dispatch.Enable(); appendErrors(); return }
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && len(os.Args[1]) >= 6 && os.Args[1][:6] == "append" { appendProgress(os.Args[1]); return }
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "decode-errors" { dispatch.Enable(); decodeErrors(); return }
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && len(os.Args[1]) >= 6 && os.Args[1][:6] == "decode" { decodeProgress(os.Args[1]); return }
	input := make([]byte, 24*1024*1024)
	output := make([]byte, base64.StdEncoding.EncodedLen(len(input)))
	dispatch.Enable()
	var ran atomic.Bool
	if len(os.Args) == 1 || os.Args[1] != "alone" {
		ready, start := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
		go func() { close(ready); <-start; ran.Store(true) }()
		<-ready
		close(start)
	}
	base64.StdEncoding.Encode(output, input)
	siblingBeforeReturn := ran.Load()
	yieldsBeforeReturn := dispatch.Count()
	for _, value := range output { if value != 'A' { panic("large output mismatch") } }
	fmt.Printf("sibling=%t bytes=%d yields=%d\n", siblingBeforeReturn, len(output), yieldsBeforeReturn)
}
